Second entry! Today was much better a bit more frustrating at the start but so much fun. I Ended up doing quite a lot I Finished Schematic Wiring, Resolved Electrical Rules, Assigned Footprints and  Imported to PCB Editor. ### 2026-10-10 – In the video i did quite a bit, I finished my Schematic Wiring, I Resolved some of the Electrical Rules, I Assigned Footprints (which was a mission since I've never done it before but did it in the en

**2.38h**

In the video i did quite a bit, I finished my Schematic Wiring, I Resolved some of the Electrical Rules, I Assigned Footprints (which was a mission since I've never done it before but did it in the end with researching how to do it), I Transitioned the PCB editor, Created Copper Traces, Ran Design rules Check, Previewed in 3D, Generated Manufacturing Files. Annoyingly  I forgot to make a Board Outline so I'm having to redo that.  And when I paused and came back I forgot to unpause. So there is about an hour and a half unflimed of trying to make the boarder and fixing some bits.
